name: the-hover-url-card-names-what-a-held-modifier-will-do
description:
Hovering a link shows its URL, and holding a modifier changes where a click on it would open. The card now says which, and the hint clears when the key comes up, with the pointer never leaving the link.

The labels follow blink::NavigationPolicyFromEventModifiers' mac branch (navigation_policy.cc) and the two intercepts browser.cc puts ahead of it: Shift and Option both peek, Cmd opens a background tab, Cmd+Shift a focused one, and Cmd+Option a little window. Option used to be SAVE_TO_DISK and Cmd+Option used to reach stock AddToNewSplit, which NOTREACHEDs on an Atrium window.

window.atriumSetNavModifiers is the receiver AtriumBrowserWindow::SetSidebarNavModifiers pushes from the native flagsChanged monitor. The sweep drives that receiver directly, the way the devbar hint scenario does, since the pointer is over the page and the document sees no keydown of its own. One real chord at the end proves the native path reaches this widget too.

assertions.desc: the card is up and showing the hovered link
with no modifier held the card says nothing extra
Cmd+Option opens the link in a little window
Option alone is NEW_WINDOW, which the peek intercept takes
The pointer never moved and the URL never changed
